title: AI and Developer Jobs in 2027
full_monologue: **Developers ignoring AI will be unemployed by 2027.** Why? Because AI is revolutionizing software development, automating tasks from coding to testing. Tools like AI-powered assistants are already writing clean, efficient code in seconds. Those who adapt will lead; those who don’t? They’ll be left behind. The future belongs to those who learn, not those who resist. So, what’s your plan? Start learning AI now or watch your skills become obsolete.
